title: The List | The Bridge
description: The List from The Bridge in Astoria, Queens: how to hear about pop-ups, meet and greets and free community sessions at 25-15 Broadway.
lede: Pop-ups, meet and greets, free community sessions. Get on The List and hear about them.

sections.heading: What you'll hear about
sections.html:
• Brand pop-ups at 25-15 Broadway
  • Meet and greets
  • Free community sessions

That's what it's for. It isn't a points program and it doesn't come with perks. It's word on what's happening at the shop.

sections.heading: What that's looked like
sections.html: Recently: a Customer Appreciation Pop-Up with a meet and greet with Havoc of Mobb Deep, and a free all-levels mat Pilates class with Eaton Botanicals. See Events for more.

sections.heading: How to get on it
sections.html: Put your name and email in the form on this page, or send us a message through the contact page and say you want on The List. Same as everything here, it's for adults 21 and older.
